title.narrative: BlueYou is transforming degraded shrimp ponds in Indonesia through Integrated Mangrove Aquaculture (IMA). This nature-based model restores mangroves within existing ponds while enabling sustainable shrimp, fish, and crab production. By naturally improving water quality and coastal ecosystems, IMA boosts yields, doubling incomes while strengthening climate resilience and biodiversity.
